title: Two Antennas, One Beam, And The Formula That Loses Half Of It
summary: Spacing and phase set everything a two-element array radiates. Push them around and watch the textbook main-lobe formula quietly drop a second beam pointing the opposite way.

sources.title: Balanis, Antenna Theory: Analysis and Design, 4th ed., chapter 6 (arrays of point sources)
